title: Gen Z trades tech for tools: Rise of the 'toolbelt generation'
claim: Zety survey of 1,000 Gen Z workers: 53% seriously considering blue-collar or skilled trade work; 65% say a degree won't protect them from AI job loss.
excerpt: More than half of Gen Z workers, 53%, are seriously considering blue-collar or skilled trade work, according to a survey by the career site Zety.
